task.summary:
CORE CHANGES: tool throwing + splitting pickups into Consumables/Tools
PICKUPS UPDATES: - Throwing in the character's facing direction with ThrowingTool size restoration - Consumables: added animation : rotation and levitation (no physics) - Tools: physics (falling, bouncing) - Outline Material for pickups added
OTHER FIXES: - Fixed some bugs that caused editor crashes - Removed Pickups respawn logic

*refactor(gameplay): stabilize character combat and tool handling*
-create inventory, status, and combat components in the character constructor -centralize the chaser state in JellyStatusComponent -simplify tool ownership to a single equipped tool -add safe hit validation and prevent duplicate hit processing -calculate thrown-tool knockback from collision impulse -remove tool input mapping contexts after throw and drop -remove unused ticking, duplicate includes, and editor-only dependencies

*feat(rounds): add replicated round state and chaser flow*
-add replicated JellyPlayerState with chaser status and penalty points -add replicated JellyGameStateBase with round phase, timer, and round counters -add JellyGameModeBase and configure custom state classes -implement waiting, countdown, playing, and results phases -add server-controlled round timers without per-frame ticking -select a random chaser at the beginning of a round -move authoritative chaser ownership to PlayerState -route role transfers through GameMode with round-state validation

feat(multiplayer): add networked combat and player colors
-add chaser-time scoring and automatic match results -wait for the minimum player count before starting -process melee attacks authoritatively on the server -replicate stun, ragdoll, and recovery -assign unique replicated colors to up to six players
Net fixes: -sinchronize tool pickup and throwing Bug fixes: - you cannot hit character if you not holding a tool.
core changes (Tools): - now can be picked up

Core changes: - add server-authoritative overlap for thrown tools - reuse the same replicated actor
Debug: - prevent immediate pickup after throwing - synchronize physics and attachment - reset hit state after pickup

CORE GAMEPLAY CHANGES: (Mainly for playtest) *add continuous matches and contextual combat* - Replace the round system with a single continuous match flow. - Add Waiting, Countdown, Playing, and Results match phases. - Track replicated chaser time and determine winners or draws. - Restart matches without disconnecting connected players. - Reset player roles, status, timers, and spawn positions between matches. - Start matches only when the required number of players is connected. - Restrict movement, jumping, throwing, and attacks outside active gameplay. - Update the HUD for the new match phases and results. - Improve ragdoll knockback and recover characters at safe ground positions. - Reattach equipped tools correctly on remote clients. - Remove manual tool dropping from the game. - Add separate HandMelee, ToolMelee, and ThrownTool hit types. - Allow the chaser to attack without a tool using shorter hand range. - Prevent runners without tools from performing melee attacks. - Give tool melee and thrown tools distinct stun and knockback values.

*gameplay expansion and UI upgrades:*
- add a chaser-only dash and movement speed advantage - tune hand melee range for unarmed chaser attacks - protect the active chaser briefly after ragdoll recovery - respawn players that fall outside the arena - return lost tools to their arena respawn point - add equipped tool information to the HUD - add an animated YOU'RE IT role-transfer notification - add a short red screen vignette when becoming the chaser

UI AND ANIMATION UPDATES:
- Add local player ring and throw aiming indicator - Prepare throws while holding Ctrl and release on animation notify - Preserve throw direction selected when releasing Ctrl - Add upper-body throw and melee montages - Support melee animations with tools and bare hands - Synchronize melee hit detection with MeleeHit notify - Replicate melee montage playback to other players - Validate pending throws and prevent duplicate release events - Prevent indicator decals from appearing on tools

RESPONSIVE ACTIONS ANIMATIONS AND UI CHANGES:
- add hold-to-aim and release-to-throw input flow - add a local throw direction indicator with an animated reveal - pause the throw montage in the prepared pose while input is held - resume the montage and throw immediately when input is released - add melee attack montage with an early notify-driven hit window - preserve locomotion using an upper-body animation slot - synchronize throw and melee animations across server and clients - cancel prepared actions on stun, round end, and equipped tool loss - add a local player identity ring and prevent decals from rendering on tools - add an animated two-part marker above the current chaser - animate the upper marker with vertical movement and the lower marker with a pulse - update marker visibility from the replicated chaser state - improve throw and melee responsiveness - remove obsolete throw-release notify handling
